title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Salary: 28,000 Permanent Full-time Fully Office-Based Near Ripley, Derbyshire

Are you an organised and proactive Accounts Assistant looking for your next opportunity within a friendly, supportive finance team? Astute Recruitment is working with an established business based near Ripley to recruit a detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to support its day-to-day finance operations. This is a varied, hands-on role offering the opportunity to take responsibility for key sales ledger activities, assist with purchase ledger processing and support the wider finance function.

The Role:

Sales Ledger & Credit Control
- Processing sales invoices and credit notes accurately and efficiently.
- Posting and allocating customer payments and cash receipts.
- Monitoring customer accounts and managing credit limits.
- Chasing overdue payments and helping to maintain healthy cash flow.
- Building effective relationships with customers and handling account queries.
- Taking and processing customer payments.

Purchase Ledger
- Supporting the processing of supplier invoices and credit notes.
- Assisting with purchase ledger administration as required.

General Accounts & Administration
- Maintaining accurate financial records and updating accounting systems.
- Providing general administrative support to the finance team.
- Assisting with ad hoc duties to support the smooth running of the department.

About You:

We're looking for someone who is organised, dependable and confident working with financial information. You'll have a proactive approach, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage your workload effectively.

Ideally, you'll bring:
- Previous experience in an accounts or finance administration role.
- An understanding of sales ledger, purchase ledger and credit control processes.
- Good IT skills, including confidence using Microsoft Excel.
- Strong communication skills and a professional approach to customer and supplier queries.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a small team.

Other roles you may have applied for; Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Purchased Ledger Clerk, Sales Ledger Clerk, Credit Controller, Finance Administrator.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
ACCOUNTS ASSISTANT - SWADLINCOTE
Up to £32,000 Full Time, Permanent Early Finish Friday
SF Partners are excited to be partnering exclusively with an established business based in Swadlincote who are looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Assistant on a full-time, permanent basis.
This is a varied, hands-on position covering both transactional finance and month-end support. The successful candidate will take ownership of Purchase and Sales Ledger duties whilst also gaining exposure to the wider accounts function.
Salary: Up to £32,000
Hours: Monday-Thursday 8:00am-4:30pm, Friday 8:00am-1:30pm
Holiday: 25 days + bank holidays, increasing with length of service
The role:
- Manage the Purchase Ledger, ensuring supplier invoices are correctly coded, recorded, matched and authorised
- Process Sales and manual customer invoices
- Credit Control and customer account queries
- Process and record cash receipts and monitor cashflow
- Bank and Balance Sheet reconciliations
- Accruals and prepayments
- Support with month-end and annual financial reporting
- Assist with the preparation of accounts and VAT returns
- Maintain and reconcile fixed asset records, including additions, disposals and depreciation
- Support with audit requirements
- Assist with Intrastat reporting
- Deal with supplier queries and reminder letters
- Support the wider Finance team as required

The ideal candidate:
My client is looking for someone with previous experience within a varied finance position who is confident working independently and using their own initiative.
You will ideally have:
- Strong Purchase and Sales Ledger experience
- Previous Credit Control experience
- Experience of reconciliations and month-end processes
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- A proactive approach and the ability to manage your own workload
- Strong communication skills
- A willingness to support across the wider finance function
- Previous manufacturing experience would be advantageous but is not essential

You do not need to be experienced across every aspect of the accounts work, as training can be provided in these areas. The key requirement is someone with a solid transactional finance background who is looking for varied and stable role.
This is a great opportunity to join an established manufacturing business in a varied role offering exposure beyond Purchase and Sales Ledger and the opportunity to continue developing within finance.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper
£26,500 - £28,000 per annum
Full time, permanent
Ripley

Our client is a well-established and expanding accountancy firm seeking a motivated Bookkeeper to join their team. This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in accounting who is keen to further develop their skills within a supportive and progressive environment.

The business is committed to investing in its employees, offering ongoing training, development, and clear opportunities for career progression as the company continues to grow.

The Role

As a trainee accountant, you will support a diverse portfolio of clients with their day-to-day accounting requirements while developing your technical knowledge and practical experience.

Key Responsibilities
- Supporting the accounting needs of multiple clients
- Preparing and maintaining accurate financial records
- Assisting with bookkeeping and reconciliations
- Working with cloud-based accounting software, including Xero & QuickBooks
- Supporting the delivery of excellent client service
- Developing your accounting knowledge through ongoing training and mentorship

About You

To be considered, you should have:
- AAT Level 3 qualification and be working towards Level 4 (or equivalent)
- Previous experience within finance
- Experience using Xero or similar accounting software
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Excellent communication skills and a team-focused approach

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual looking to build a long-term career within accountancy and join a business that actively supports professional growth and development.

title: Credit Control
description:
Credit Controller (9 Month FTC)
Chesterfield, Derbyshire (Hybrid Working)

We're currently recruiting for a Credit Controller to join a busy and supportive finance team based in Chesterfield. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced credit professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and building strong customer relationships.

The Role

As a Credit Controller, you'll play a key role in managing customer accounts, ensuring payments are received in line with agreed terms, and reducing outstanding debt. You'll work closely with both customers and internal teams to maintain accurate records and resolve queries efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Conduct credit checks for new and existing customers
- Manage the aged debtor ledger and collect outstanding balances against targets
- Maintain regular contact with customers via phone and email
- Investigate and resolve account queries in a timely manner
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure accurate customer records and billing information
- Raise invoices and credit notes, including any necessary adjustments
- Upload invoices to customer portals and resolve portal-related issues
- Support customers with payment processes (bank details, payment links, card payments)
- Post and allocate receipts within the finance system and assist with refunds
- Identify and escalate high-risk accounts where necessary
- Support wider finance tasks on an ad hoc basis

About You
- Experienced in credit control or accounts receivable
- Comfortable working in a high-volume, fast-paced environment
- Strong communicator with a professional and approachable manner
- Highly organised with a methodical approach to problem-solving
- Confident managing multiple customer portals and systems
- Proactive and solutions-focused, with strong reconciliation skills

What's On Offer
- Hybrid working
- Flexible working hours
- Medical cover
- Company pension

If this looks like a role of interest then please get in touch or apply now!

title: Credit Controller/Accounts Assistant
description:
Join Our Team at Smurfit Westrock!

Are you searching for a workplace that values you and your growth? At Smurfit Westrock, we re committed to sustainability, employee well-being, and personal development.

About Us

We are a global leader in sustainable paper and packaging. Our focus is on the health and safety of our employees, the well-being of our communities, and delivering exceptional service to our customers. We support our team members to reach their full potential in an inclusive environment that values diversity.

The Role

This role is responsible for supporting the Chesterfield site's financial operations by managing credit control, maintaining the sales ledger, and ensuring general ledger transactions are processed accurately and on time. The position focuses on reducing overdue debt, minimising bad debt risk, and providing reliable financial reporting and analysis to support business performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Proactively manage debt collection and maintain positive customer relationships.
- Investigate and resolve customer invoice and payment queries.
- Monitor customer credit limits, payment terms, and conduct regular credit reviews.
- Set up new customer accounts and assess credit risk.
- Implement credit control procedures, including recommending account stops where necessary.
- Maintain, administer, and reconcile the Sales Ledger and General Ledger.
- Record and allocate cash receipts accurately.
- Produce regular, monthly, and ad hoc financial reports.
- Analyse financial data and accounts for management reporting and audit purposes.
- Prepare and post journals, including those outside of credit management activities.
- Support sales and operational teams by providing information on customer payment performance and credit issues.
- Manage customer invoicing portals and resolve invoice rejections promptly.
- Provide departmental cover during holidays and sickness absence.
- Assist with additional finance and reporting tasks as required by management.

This is a varied finance role combining credit control, sales ledger management, financial reporting, account reconciliations, journal preparation, and data analysis, with responsibility for supporting cash flow, reducing financial risk, and providing accurate financial information to the business.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary & benefits, including annual leave, pension, and a Cycle to Work scheme
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- 24/7 confidential support for you and your family
- Flexible working options and family-friendly policies
- Guaranteed interview for candidates meeting essential criteria (Disability Confident Employer)

Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help us build a sustainable future together.

Smurfit Westrock reserve the right to only shortlist candidates who meet both the Essential and Desirable Criteria.

We are an equal opportunities employer, and we welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their sex; religious or similar philosophical belief; political opinion; race; age; sexual orientation; or, whether they are married or are in a civil partnership; or, whether they are disabled; or whether they have undergone, are undergoing or intend to undergo gender reassignment.

We practice equality of opportunity in employment and select the best person for the job.

title: Purchase Ledger Assistant
description:
Purchase Ledger Administrator
£33,240 per annum
Full-time, Monday to Friday
Looking at Temp to Perm or straight Perm, depending on the candidate
South Derbyshire

SF Partners are recruiting for a Purchase Ledger Administrator to join a busy Head Office finance team.

This is a varied finance role with a strong focus on purchase ledger, supplier accounts and invoice processing, alongside some wider finance administration. You'll work closely with the Finance and Operations teams, helping to keep the ledger accurate and ensuring suppliers and internal teams receive a responsive service.

The role will include:
- Managing and maintaining supplier accounts across your assigned areas of the purchase ledger
- Matching invoices to purchases and chasing outstanding orders
- Coding invoices to the correct nominal codes
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving discrepancies
- Processing BACS payments
- Accurately entering invoice information into Insphire and Sage, including the correct VAT treatment
- Liaising with suppliers and depots to resolve queries and keep the ledger running smoothly
- Keeping the trial balance up to date for review
- Processing petty cash receipts and ensuring transactions are correctly coded
- Supporting month-end and year-end accounts
- Assisting with year-end audit preparation
- Dealing with customer and supplier queries in a professional and timely manner
- Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team where required

About you:
We're looking for someone with previous experience in purchase ledger, accounts or finance administration, who is confident working with financial information and comfortable communicating with suppliers and colleagues.

You'll need to be:
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail
- Confident using finance systems and Microsoft Office
- Comfortable handling invoice processing, reconciliations and supplier queries
- A clear and professional communicator
- Able to work independently while also being part of a wider team
- Reliable, positive and committed to producing accurate work

Previous purchase ledger experience would be desirable, but we'd also consider someone with a solid accounts or finance administration background who is looking to develop further within a finance team.

The package:
- £33,240 per annum
- Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
- 33 days' holiday including bank holidays and festive shutdown
- Company pension scheme
- Life assurance
If you're an experienced Purchase Ledger or Accounts Administrator looking for your next opportunity, apply now and SF Partners will be in touch to discuss the role.
